verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is managed sandbox infrastructure for users' own AI agents. A SaaS platform of this kind could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that it hosts external agents (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain Deep Agents) as a backend; these are building blocks and integrations, not a built-in assistant you can delegate tasks to, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
